                                          BUILDINGS BULLETIN 2008-006
                                                         Code Interpretation


       Supersedes:            None

             Issuer:          Fatma M. Amer, P.E.
         Issuer Title:        Deputy Commissioner and Chief Code Engineer.

    Issuance Date:            June 26, 2008

           Purpose:           This document is to clarify that the term “Fire Command Station” is interpreted to mean “Fire
                              Command Center”.

      Related Code             T28    109.3                   BC    911                 BC   K101.1 (§2.7.8.4)
        Section(s):             BC    K101.1                  MC    607.3.2.1
                                      (§2.27.3.2.1(a),              Item #6
                                      (b), (f)(2) and
                                      (f)(4))

         Subject(s):          Fire protection system, Fire alarm, Fire command center


The term Fire Command Station is mentioned in the 1968 Code. To be consistent with the New Construction
Codes, whenever such term is mentioned in the New Construction Codes it is construed to mean Fire Command
Center.
